test_cases.name: single_page_with_images
test_cases.input: Clone https://example.com including every image and tell me the tech stack
assertions: Runs scripts/clone_site.py against the named seed with depth 0
Writes index.html, assets, MANIFEST.json, and TECH.md
Reports image count and detected technology from the inventory, not a guess

test_cases.name: same_origin_crawl
test_cases.input: Mirror the whole public site at https://example.com, pages and images, offline
assertions: Sets --depth above 0 and a max-pages cap
Records failed assets instead of dropping them

test_cases.name: webgl_without_file
test_cases.input: Clone this Three.js product page and generate the 3D asset if they never shipped a model
assertions: Runs clone_site.py and reads SCENE.md for a glb or gltf
If none downloaded, runs generate_standin.py and writes an original glTF plus scene/viewer.html
Does not copy a trademarked mesh
